meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页操作、填表、截图与数据抓取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要操作网页,手动填表、截图或抓数据很耗时
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tasks like form filling, screenshots, and data extraction.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat browser chores like filling forms and grabbing data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以替你操作浏览器：打开网址、点击链接、填写表单、截图、保存 PDF 等，并根据页面元素反馈执行步骤。
howto.when: 当你提出需要打开网页、填写表单、截图或抓取页面信息等浏览器操作请求时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截图保存
say.note: 会打开网页并生成截图文件

say.text: 在搜索框输入“天气”并点击搜索按钮
say.note: 先读取页面元素，再填写并点击

say.text: 提取当前页面的标题和所有链接
say.note: 返回页面标题与链接列表

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can operate the browser for you: open URLs, click links, fill forms, take screenshots, save PDFs, and more, acting on the elements it finds on the page.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask for browser actions such as opening a website, filling a form, taking a screenshot, or extracting page information.

say_en.text: Open example.com and save a screenshot
say_en.note: Opens the page and produces a screenshot file

say_en.text: Type "weather" in the search box and click the search button
say_en.note: Reads page elements first, then fills and clicks

say_en.text: Extract the page title and all links
say_en.note: Returns the title and link list
